title: Christmas at The Anchor, and a favour to ask
preheader: Christmas dinner with the people you actually like, plus what is on through December.

image.alt: A Christmas dinner at The Anchor: roast beef, a Yorkshire pudding, pigs in blankets, stuffing, roast potatoes, mash, peas and sprouts

data.placeholder_caption: Christmas table laid up, warm low light
data.headline: Christmas dinner with the people you actually like
body: Christmas dinner is on from 10 November to 20 December. Friends, family, or the group you always mean to see more of, round one table with everyone picking their own courses.
It is the same kitchen and the same faces you get the rest of the year, just with better trimmings and a lot more tinsel.

data.heading: What comes with it
body: Every adult gets a glass of prosecco, swappable for orange juice. Dinner comes with pigs in blankets, stuffing, Yorkshire pudding, roast potatoes, mash, peas and sprouts.
list_items: Everyone picks their own courses, so vegetarian guests are not an afterthought
Six guests or more, any day except Monday, when the kitchen is closed
£10 per person deposit, taken straight off your bill

data.heading: Does your work Christmas do need a home?
data.body: If you are the one organising it, or you know who is, please put us in the running. We are a small family-run pub and a work party booked here genuinely makes our December. It would mean the world to us.

data.label: Send it to whoever organises yours

data.heading: Festive nights out
data.body: Four of them between now and Christmas, and every one is a good excuse to get people together. Booking is open on all of them.

events.title: Tasting Night
events.detail: A premium tasting night with dinner provided, 7pm. The theme and the products are still under wraps, so watch this space.

events.title: Tinsel & Trivia Quiz Night
events.detail: £3 cash entry, 7pm. Lively rounds with a festive nod, and dinner beforehand if you fancy it.

events.title: Sleigh My Name: Festive Music Bingo
events.detail: £5, 7pm. Two themed rounds with Nikki hosting, and it gets loud in the best way.

events.title: Christmas Jackpot Cash Bingo
events.detail: £10 cash books, 10 games, 7pm, with a rollover Snowball waiting to go.

data.body: We want this Christmas to be the best one this village has had in a long time, and honestly, we cannot do that part on our own. Come and be part of it.
Book a table, book the works do, or just come in for a pint and tell us what you fancy this year. We would rather hear from you than not.

data.ps_body: If you only do one thing with this email, pass the work party bit on to whoever organises yours. That is the one that really helps us.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before. If you would rather not hear about what is on, one tap below stops it.
